description: Role: Deployer. Sector: Travel. System: Psychological vulnerability targeting system. Intended use: Deploy a travel‑booking assistant that exploits the fear of missing out among young adults to upsell premium packages. Input data: Social media activity, age, travel preferences, browsing patterns.

Role: Provider. Sector: Finance. System: Personality‑based fraud risk predictor. Intended use: Sell a credit‑card fraud detection system that denies credit to users predicted to commit fraud based on personality analysis. Input data: Transaction history, social media sentiment, psychometric scores, location data.

Role: Provider. Sector: Advertising. System: Cross‑platform facial image harvesting system. Intended use: Sell a social‑media monitoring tool that scrapes user‑uploaded photos to create a cross‑platform facial‑recognition repository for targeted advertising. Input data: User photos, hashtags, upload timestamps, device identifiers.

Role: Provider. Sector: Tourism. System: Travel photo facial data scraper. Intended use: Offer a tourism‑promotion platform that harvests tourists’ facial photos from travel blogs to enrich a facial‑recognition database for future marketing. Input data: Blog images, GPS tags, user comments, travel dates.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Finance. System: Subliminal haptic persuasion system. Intended use: Implement a mobile app that uses hidden haptic feedback to encourage users to accept higher‑interest loans. Input data: Touchscreen interactions, credit scores, financial history, device sensor data.

Role: Provider. Sector: Employment, workers’ management and access to self‑employment. System: Leadership development recruitment AI. Intended use: AI platform that automates the screening of candidates for a multinational's leadership development program. Input data: Performance reviews, psychometric tests, career trajectories.

Role: Provider. Sector: Employment, workers’ management and access to self‑employment. System: Government recruitment AI. Intended use: AI platform that automates the screening of job applications for a government agency, including bias‑checking. Input data: Applicant CVs, questionnaire responses, background checks.

Role: Provider. Sector: Product safety AI systems. System: Automotive emergency braking AI. Intended use: AI safety component for autonomous vehicle braking systems, required to undergo EU type‑approval conformity assessment. Input data: Lidar, radar, camera feeds, vehicle speed.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits. System: Unemployment benefit eligibility AI. Intended use: AI that determines eligibility for unemployment benefits based on income and work history, with automatic benefit allocation. Input data: Tax records, employment contracts, bank statements.

Role: Provider. Sector: Administration of justice and democratic processes. System: Legal fact‑extraction AI. Intended use: AI system used by courts to automatically extract relevant facts from large document bundles and suggest legal arguments. Input data: Case files, statutes, prior judgments.

Role: Provider. Sector: Agriculture. System: Time‑series forecasting model. Intended use: Tool that forecasts agricultural yield for small farms to aid planning, not used for insurance underwriting. Input data: Open satellite imagery, weather forecasts, anonymised farm production records.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Consumer Technology. System: Pattern‑recognition dashboard. Intended use: AI‑enhanced personal habit‑tracking app that visualises weekly patterns. Input data: Anonymised habit logs, public habit‑formation studies.

Role: Provider. Sector: Culture. System: Sentiment aggregation platform. Intended use: Tool that analyses public sentiment on local cultural events to aid organizers. Input data: Public social‑media posts, anonymised event feedback surveys.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Tourism. System: Content‑based recommendation engine. Intended use: AI‑based itinerary planner for tourists that suggests attractions based on preferences. Input data: Public points‑of‑interest data, anonymised user preference surveys.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Consumer Technology. System: Recommendation engine. Intended use: AI‑based personal productivity assistant that suggests task prioritisation. Input data: Anonymised task lists, public productivity research.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Personalisation. System: Template‑based graphic generator. Intended use: AI that generates decorative holiday greeting cards from user‑provided text. Input data: User text, public holiday image assets.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Pet care. System: Rule‑based tip generator. Intended use: AI that offers simple pet training tip cards based on pet type entered by the user. Input data: User pet type, public training guides.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Personal development. System: Rule‑based habit recommender. Intended use: AI that offers simple daily habit suggestions based on user‑selected improvement area. Input data: User improvement area, public habit‑building tips.

Role: Deployer. Sector: Entertainment. System: Content‑based recommendation engine. Intended use: AI that suggests movie titles based on genre and mood selected by the user. Input data: User genre/mood selections, public movie metadata.
Role: Provider. Sector: Creative writing. System: Template‑based poem generator. Intended use: AI that generates short poetry from user‑provided themes. Input data: User themes, public poetry corpus.
